description: What is being built right now: every open pull request and special branch, mapped (zero-LLM, from the diff) to the product areas and features it touches. Two kinds of row, told apart by isLane. A WORK row is a pull request heading somewhere. Read filesChanged, areas, featureRefs, and hasUnmappedWork (true = it touches code outside any known feature, i.e. new ground not yet on the map). A LANE row IS the release lane itself: its changes are already merged and waiting to be promoted, so commitsAhead is its honest size, mergedWork lists the pull requests riding in it, and promotesTo names where it lands. isStaging is true for both a lane and work heading into one.
name: list_in_flight
title: List work in flight
